Rashi on Shabbat 99b:10:1.english: With a juicy cake of figs - Which sticks to the face of the wall.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:10:2.hebrew: ואמאי - מיחייב? הא מתני' ד' אמות קתני, ואפילו מצומצמות. וכי נח בפני הכותל, נתמעט הזריקה מד' אמות כדי מקום הדבילה, וקתני חייב, כיון דמעיקרא ד' אמות הוה:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:10:2.english: And why - is he liable? Surely the Mishnah teaches four cubits, even exact [four cubits]; and when it comes to rest against the wall, the throw is reduced from four cubits by the space of the fig cake, yet it teaches [that he is] liable, since originally it was four cubits.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:11:1.hebrew: התם לא מיבטיל ליה - דבילה, הלכך לאו מיעוט הוא:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:11:1.english: There, he does not nullify it - [the] cake of pressed figs; therefore, it is not a diminution.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:12:1.hebrew: על גבי יתידות - דקות שהיו גבוהות י' ואין רחבות ד', ודף זה רחב ד', עשאו רשות היחיד:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:12:1.english: On top of stakes - Thin [ones] that were ten [handbreadths] high and not four [handbreadths] wide, and this board is four [handbreadths] wide, [so] it made it a private domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:12:2.english: What [is the ruling] - [To become] liable for this throw?

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:13:1.hebrew: וחפץ על גביו - ואם תימצי לומר הוא. אם תימצי לומר כר' יוחנן, דהנחת חפץ ועשיית מחיצה בהדי הדדי לא מיחייב, הכא ודאי אדף לא מיחייב, מיהו אחפץ מהו לחיובי:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:13:1.english: And an object atop it - And this is an "if you say" [dilemma]: if you say [the law] is in accordance with Rabbi Yochanan, that [when] the placement of an object and the making of a partition [occur] simultaneously one is not liable, here [one is] certainly not liable for the board; however, for the object, what is [the law regarding] holding [him] liable?

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:13:2.english: That it is impossible [for it] not to be lifted - The object [is lifted] from upon the board at the time of the board's landing, and then it comes to rest.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:13:3.hebrew: כעשיית מחיצה - ברישא והדר הנחת החפץ דמי, חייב, דבשעת הנחתו כבר נעשה דף רה"י:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:13:3.english: Like the making of a partition - first, and then the placement of the object, it is [like] — [he is] liable, for at the time of its placement, the board has already become a private domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:14:1.english: That is its placement - And if one took some of it and carried [it] out, it is [considered] a lifting.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:1:1.hebrew: מחיצה י' - שיהא הממלא עומד לפנים מן המחיצה וממלא:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:1:1.english: A partition [of] ten [handbreadths] - So that the one drawing [water] stands inside the partition and draws.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:1:2.hebrew: ואין שותין הימנה - לעמוד על שפתה ולשאוב בכלי ולהכניס ראשו לחללה ולשתות, כדתנן: "לא יעמוד אדם ברה"ר וישתה ברה"י, שמא ימשוך הכלי אצלו":
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:1:2.english: And one may not drink from it - [That is,] to stand on its edge, draw [water] with a vessel, insert his head into its interior, and drink; as we learned in a Mishnah: "A person may not stand in the public domain and drink in the private domain, lest he draw the vessel toward himself."

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:1:3.english: Unless he inserts his head and most of his [body] - into the place where he is drinking.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:2:1.english: Behold, [there is] lifting in a prohibited [manner] - From the public domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:2:2.english: Behold, [the] placing [is] in a prohibited [manner] - In a private domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:2:3.hebrew: ממקום פטור קאתיא - שאי אפשר שלא הגביה תחילה למעלה מן העמוד, שהוא מקום פטור, שאינו אויר רה"ר, ואויר רה"י נמי לא הוי. דכי אמרינן רה"י עולה עד לרקיע, ה"מ כנגד רה"י, אבל האי מקמי דלימטי לאויר עמוד אגבהיה למעלה מעשרה:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:2:3.english: It comes from an exempt domain - For it is impossible that he did not first lift [it] above the column, which is an exempt domain, as it is not the airspace of the public domain, nor is it the airspace of a private domain either. For when we say [that] a private domain extends upward to the sky, that applies [only] directly above the private domain; but [in] this [case], before it reached the airspace of the column, he lifted it above ten [handbreadths].

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:3:1.english: It is our Mishnah - One who takes from them and one who places upon them is liable.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:3:2.english: In each other's spittle you spit - You all spit one [and the same] spittle.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:4:1.english: And do you not hold [so] - That it is [taught in] our Mishnah.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:4:2.english: With a needle - For it is not high.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:5:1.hebrew: דאית לה - לסלע מורשא נמוך מי'. וכיון דכולה גבוהה י' בר מההיא מורשא, ואיהו לא הוי מקום חשוב, הוי ליה חורי רשות היחיד:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:5:1.english: That it has - [That] the boulder [has] a protrusion lower than ten [handbreadths]. And since all of it is ten [handbreadths] high except for that protrusion, and it is not a significant place, it is [considered] holes of a private domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:5:2.hebrew: אי נמי דרמיא - מחט בחריץ שבסלע שבראשו, ולא נפל מלמעלה מי', אלא לתוך י':
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:5:2.english: Alternatively, that [it] is placed - a needle in a groove in the rock at its top, and it did not fall from above ten [handbreadths], but rather into [within] ten [handbreadths].

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:6:1.hebrew: מוקף לכרמלית - בכותל זה הקיפו בקעה שהיתה כרמלית, ועל ידו נעשית רה"י, כגון שהוקף לדירה, או לא הקיפו בו אלא בית סאתים:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:6:1.english: Surrounds a karmelit - With this wall they surrounded a valley that was a karmelit, and through it, [the valley] became a private domain — such as where it was enclosed for habitation, or [where] they enclosed with it only [an area of] two se'ah.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:6:2.hebrew: וזרק - מרה"ר ונח על ראשו, מהו:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:6:2.english: And [one] threw - from the public domain and it landed on its top, what is [the ruling]?

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:6:3.hebrew: או דילמא כיון - דכותל זה עשאה לכרמלית זו רה"י:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:6:3.english: Or perhaps since - this wall made this karmelit a private domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:6:4.english: It is as though it is filled - And the entire interior space is, next to its [the wall's] top, like solid ground.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:7:1.hebrew: לאחרים - כל החלל עשאו רה"י:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:7:1.english: For others - it renders the entire interior space a private domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:7:2.english: For itself, [is it] not all the more so - [This refers to] the top of the wall.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:8:1.hebrew: ועקר ממנה חוליא - והניחו ברה"ר, מי מיחייב? אע"ג דמקמי עקירה לאו רה"י הוה, בשעת עקירה מיהא רה"י הוה:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:8:1.english: And he uprooted a segment [of earth] from it - and placed it in the public domain, is he liable? Even though before the lifting it was not a private domain, at the time of the lifting, at any rate, it was a private domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 99b:8:2.hebrew: וסילוק מחיצה - בהנחה זו נסתלקה מחיצת הבור שנתמעטה מעשרה. מי מהני האי מיעוטא למיפטריה או לא:
Rashi on Shabbat 99b:8:2.english: And the removal of the partition - Through this placement, the partition of the pit was removed, as it was diminished below ten [handbreadths]. Does this diminution avail to exempt him, or not?

Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:10:1.hebrew: ואמאי והא קא ממעט מארבע אמות - פירש בקונטרס דמשמע ליה דמיירי אפילו בד' אמות מצומצמות, שעובי הדבילה ממעט מדי' אמות. וקשה לר"י, דבענין זה אין נראה שיתחייב, כיון שאיגודו בפנים — כמו מוציא חצי קופה לרה"ר, דאינו חייב עד שיוציאנה כולה לחוץ; דאטו אם זרק אדם רומח וכל דבר ארוך כל שהוא יתחייב כיון שראשו אחד יצא חוץ לד' אמות? ואם בזורק ד' אמות הכי גמירי לה שיתחייב בכה"ג, א"כ היכי פשיט מינה? ועוד, דאמאי משמע ליה טפי בהאי דזרק ארבע אמות בכותל דהוו מצומצמות, משאר ארבע אמות השנויות בכל הש"ס? ונראה לר"י דמיירי הכא שזרק חוץ לארבע אמות כמו בכל מקום, והכי פריך: "והא קא ממעט מד' אמות" — שמקום הדבילה נתבטלה מתורת רשות הרבים, שבטל לכותל והרי הוא ככותל עב, ולא הוי עוד על גביו רשות הרבים, ואם זרק מחט או קוץ ד' אמות ונח על הדבילה או נתקע בתוכו היה פטור, דהרי מקום הדבילה נתמעט מדין רשות הרבים; ואפ"ה חייב, הואיל ובתחילת הזריקה עד קודם הנחה היה שם רה"ר עליו, והנחה ומיעוט רה"ר בהדי הדדי קא אתו; והכא נמי הוה לן למימר הנחה וסילוק מחיצה בהדי הדדי קאתו. ומשני: התם לא מבטלי, ולהכי לא מבטל רה"ר:
Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:10:1.english: "And why? It reduces [the distance] from four cubits" - Rashi explained that it appears to him that [the Gemara] is dealing even with exact four cubits, where the thickness of the fig-cake reduces [the throw] from four cubits. And this is difficult for the Ri [Rabbenu Yitzchak]: for in such a case it does not seem [reasonable] that one should be liable, since it is connected [to the area] inside [the four cubits] — like one who carries out half a basket into the public domain, who is not liable until he carries all of it out. For is it so that if a person throws a spear or any long object of any length, he will be liable just because one end of it went outside the four cubits? And if with regard to throwing four cubits it was taught as a tradition that one is liable in such a case, if so, how does [the Gemara] resolve [the question about a partition] from it? And furthermore, why does it seem to him more [likely] in this case, where one threw four cubits against a wall, that they are exact [four cubits], than in all other [cases of] four cubits taught throughout the entire Talmud? Rather, it appears to the Ri that [the Gemara] is dealing here with a case where he threw [it] beyond four cubits, just as in every [other] place, and this is what [the Gemara] asks: "It reduces [the area] of four cubits" — for the place of the fig-cake has become nullified from the legal status of a public domain, since it became nullified [and incorporated] into the wall, and it is now like a thick wall, and [the space] on top of it is no longer a public domain, so that if one were to throw a needle or a thorn four cubits and it rested on the fig-cake or became stuck in it, he would be exempt, for the place of the fig-cake has been reduced [and removed] from the status of a public domain; and even so, he is liable, since at the beginning of the throw until just before [its] landing, it still had the status of a public domain, and the landing and the reduction of the public domain come simultaneously; and here too, we should say [that] the landing and the removal of the partition come simultaneously. And [the Gemara] answers: There, [the figs] are not nullified [as part of the wall], and therefore it does not nullify the public domain.

Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:12:1.hebrew: זרק דף כו' הנחת חפץ ועשיית מחיצה כו' - וא"ת: אפילו ליכא בקיעת גדיים, היכי חשוב לשוייה תחתיו רה"י? מ"ש מטרסקל ועמוד ברה"ר, גבוה י' ורחב ד' ואין בעיקרו ד', דאמרינן (לקמן שבת דף קא.): "זרק ונח על גביו חייב", משמע דוקא על גביו, אבל תחתיו לא? ואומר ר"י: כגון שיש שתי מחיצות של יתידות, ובשלישית אמרינן פי תקרת דף יורד וסותם:
Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:12:1.english: "[If] he threw a board, etc. The placement of an object and the establishment of a partition, etc." - And if you ask: Even where there is no passage of goats, how is it considered [effective] to render [the space] beneath it a private domain? How is it different from a basket (teraskal) or a pillar in the public domain [that is] ten [handbreadths] high and four [handbreadths] wide, while its base is not four [handbreadths wide], concerning which we say (below, Shabbat 101a): "[If] one threw [an object] and it landed on top of it, he is liable," implying specifically on top of it, but not beneath it? And Ri says: [This refers to a case] where there are two walls of stakes, and on the third [side] we say [that] the edge of the board's roof descends and closes [it].

Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:1:1.hebrew: אלא אם כן עשו לה מחיצה גבוה י' טפחים - אבל פסין לא מהני אלא בבאר מים חיים או בור הרבים, כדתנן בפרק עושין פסין (עירובין דף כב:): אבל בור היחיד עושין לו מחיצה כו'. ודווקא עמוק י' ורוחב ארבע דהוי רה"י, אבל פחות מיכן דהוי כרמלית — לא החמירו כל כך, ומשתרי שפיר בפסין. הרב פור"ת:
Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:1:1.english: "Unless they constructed a partition for it ten handbreadths high" - However, corner-boards [passin] are not effective except for a well of living water or a public pit, as we learned in the Mishnah in the chapter [entitled] Osin Passin (Eruvin 22b): "But for a private pit, one makes a partition for it, etc." And [this applies] specifically [when the pit is] ten [handbreadths] deep and four [handbreadths] wide, so that it is a private domain; but [when it is] less than that, so that it is a karmelit — they were not so stringent, and it is well permitted with corner-boards. Rabbi Porat.

Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:2:1.hebrew: או דילמא כיון דממקום פטור קא אתיא לא - ואם תאמר: ומאי קמיבעיא ליה? תיפשוט מדתניא בפ"ק (דף ו.): המוציא מחנות לפלטיא דרך סטיו חייב, ואחד המושיט ואחד הזורק חייב; ואמרינן לעיל (שבת דף צב.): המוציא משוי למעלה מעשרה חייב. ומפרש הרב פור"ת דדוקא כשפסק כחו במקום פטור קמיבעיא ליה, כגון שזרק למעלה מי' כנגד אויר רה"ר, וירד האבן באלכסון ונחה על העמוד, דירידה זו אינו מכחו הראשון אלא כח כחו היא, וכיון דממקום פטור קא אתיא, יש הפסק בין עקירה ראשונה להנחה. אבל אם זרק ממש כנגד העמוד, שלא הלכה באלכסון כלל אלא הלכה מכחו עד העמוד — ודאי חייב. ודווקא בזורק מבעיא ליה כדפי', אבל מוציא ומכניס פשיטא ליה דחייב. והא דמייתי ראיה מהנושא והנותן ע"ג חייב — היינו משום דמשמע ליה דמיירי בכל ענין, בין בזורק בין במושיט, כדתניא ברישא: הזורק פטור והמושיט חייב. והשתא לא דמי למוציא מחנות לפלטיא דרך סטיו, דהתם מכחו בא לרה"ר:
Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:2:1.english: Or perhaps, since it comes from an exempt domain, [he is] not [liable] - And if you will say: What is his dilemma? Let him resolve [it] from what was taught in a baraita in the first chapter (6a): "One who carries out from a store to a plaza via a colonnade is liable, and both one who hands over and one who throws are liable," and we say above (Shabbat 92a): "One who carries out a load above ten [handbreadths] is liable." And Rabbi Porat explains that specifically when his force ceased in an exempt domain is he in doubt — for example, where he threw [a stone] above ten [handbreadths] opposite the airspace of the public domain, and the stone descended diagonally and landed on the column, for this descent is not from his initial force, rather it is a secondary force [ko'ach kocho], and since it comes from an exempt domain, there is an interruption between the initial lifting and the placing. However, if he threw [it] directly toward the column, such that it did not travel diagonally at all, rather it traveled by his force all the way to the column, he is certainly liable. And specifically regarding one who throws is he in doubt, as I have explained; however, regarding one who carries out or brings in, it is obvious to him that he is liable. And the fact that he brings proof from [the Mishnah]: "One who lifts and places atop them is liable" — this is because it implies to him that it refers to every case, whether by throwing or by handing over, just as it was taught in the first clause: "One who throws is exempt, and one who hands over is liable." And now, it is not comparable to one who carries out from a store to a plaza via a colonnade, for there it comes to the public domain by his [own] force.

Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:6:1.hebrew: ומוקף לכרמלית ועשאו רה"י - אומר ר"י, דמשמע דדוקא מוקף לכרמלית, דכיון דמוקף לכרמלית אין כ"כ סברא שיעשה רה"י מטעם דלאחרים עושה מחיצה; אבל מוקפת לרה"ר ועשאו רה"י — פשיטא דלעצמו נמי מהני. ומשום חורי רה"י ליכא לחיוביה כמו רמיא בחריצא דלעיל, דלא ניחא תשמישתיה לבני רה"י כולי האי על הכותל:
Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:6:1.english: And it surrounds a karmelit and renders it a private domain - Ri says that [the Gemara] implies specifically [when it] surrounds a karmelit, for since it surrounds a karmelit, there is not as much reason that it should become a private domain on the grounds that it makes a partition for others; however, [when it] surrounds a public domain and renders it a private domain, it is obvious that it is effective for itself as well. And on account of [the law of] holes of a private domain, one cannot hold him liable as [in the case of] "placed in a groove" above, because its use atop the wall is not so convenient for the residents of the private domain.

Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:7:1.hebrew: לאחרים עושה מחיצה כו' - גבי חוליא דבור לא שייך למימר הכי, ליחייב המשתמש מרה"ר על גבה, כיון שאין החוליא עצמו גבוה י':
Tosafot on Shabbat 99b:7:1.english: "[If] it creates a partition for others, etc." - With regard to the rim of a pit, it is not applicable to say this — that one who uses its top from the public domain should be liable — since the rim itself is not ten [handbreadths] high.
